text: Send me three emojis that sum up our last date. I get three guesses to decode them, and every miss costs you a compliment.
Do your best impression of me first thing in the morning. I score it out of 10, and anything under 7 means you go again.
On video, give me a 60-second tour of your room as if it were a museum, with me as its most famous exhibit.
Feed me a snack you know I love while I keep my eyes shut. If I guess what it is, you owe me a kiss.
Send me a voice note reading my last text to you as if it were the most romantic line ever written.
Rename me in your phone to the most flattering nickname you can think of and send me a screenshot.
Hide a handwritten compliment somewhere I'll find it later today, and don't tell me where.
Hold both my hands and keep eye contact for 60 seconds. Whoever laughs first owes the other a kiss.
On a video call, recreate the face you made the first time you saw me, then tell me what you were thinking.
Play a song that reminds you of me and sing me your favorite line while looking me in the eye.
Sit on my lap facing me and stay there until your next turn.
Text me the cheesiest pickup line you know, then follow it with one you actually mean.
On video, take off one piece of clothing for every compliment I give you in the next two minutes.
Text me a message that starts "Tonight I'm going to…" and finish it in exactly ten words. Make every word count.
Set a 10-minute timer. Every two minutes, take off one item of my clothing, your choice which.
Bring your lips as close to mine as you can for 30 seconds without kissing me. If you crack first, I choose where you kiss me next.
Send me a photo in the underwear you'd most like me to take off you.
Call me and talk me through, in detail, the first five minutes after I walk through your door tonight.
Kiss your way from my ankle to my knee, as slowly as you can stand.
Lie still with your hands behind your head for two minutes while I touch you wherever I like. If your hands move, the clock restarts.
On a video call, show me with your hands, not words, exactly how you'd want me to touch you.
Send me a sext in three parts, ten minutes apart, each one more explicit than the last.
Guide my hands to where you most want to be touched and hold them there for one minute.
Feed me a strawberry (or any fruit) using only your mouth, no hands allowed.
On video, slowly unbutton or unzip what you're wearing, and stop only when I say "stop".
Challenge me to a thumb war, best of three. The loser makes the winner breakfast tomorrow.
Send me a selfie of the face you'd make if I turned up at your door right now.
Draw my portrait in 60 seconds with your non-dominant hand, then sign it and give it to me.
Text me the exact moment today you thought about me, in one sentence starting with "At…".
Send me a photo of the view from where you are right now, captioned with what you'd be doing if I were there.
Give me a 30-second pep talk as if I were about to win an award for being your favorite person.
Write three words that describe me on my palm with your fingertip and make me guess them.
Record a 15-second video saying goodnight to me as if we were already in bed together.
Kiss me like it's our very first kiss: nervous, unsure and a little awkward.
On a video call, make me blush in under a minute without saying anything explicit.
Wear something of mine for the rest of the evening, and tell me why you picked it.
Kiss me without using your hands. The first one to use their hands takes off an item of clothing.
Send me a whispered voice note describing what you're wearing and which piece you'd let me take off first.
Sit behind me and kiss along my shoulders while I count down from 30. I can't turn around until I reach zero.
Text me the three places in your home where you most want to have s*x with me, ranked.
Hold my wrists above my head and kiss me until I ask you to stop.
Send me a mirror photo wearing only one item of clothing, your choice which.
Take my top off, then trace a slow line of kisses all the way down my back.
On video, tell me the dirtiest thing you've thought about me today, then act out a few seconds of it.
Straddle me and kiss me for one full minute without letting me touch you.
Write a steamy paragraph about us, at least five sentences, and send it to me as a voice note.
Put an ice cube in your mouth, choose a spot on my body and kiss it until the ice melts.
Text me the one thing you've always wanted to try in bed but never asked for, then ask me for it properly.
Lie back and let me undress you completely, one item at a time, with no helping.
On video, show me what you'd wear to bed if you knew I was coming over, then put it on.
Send me a voice note narrating my day so far like a nature documentary.
Give me a ridiculous new hairstyle using only your hands. I have to keep it until my next turn.
Text me our relationship as a movie: a title, a tagline and who'd play each of us.
Hold my face in your hands and give me three honest compliments without looking away.
Send me a photo of one thing you'd pack if we ran away together for a weekend, with a one-line reason.
Write "mine" with a pen somewhere on me that only the two of us will see.
On a video call, hold my gaze through the camera for 30 seconds without speaking.
Hold my hand the way you did on our first date, and don't let go until your next turn.
Text me five words that describe the way I kiss.
Kiss me ten times, never twice in the same spot, then tell me which one was your favorite.
Send me a voice note humming the song that feels most like us, and make me name it.
Give me a compliment for every letter of my name.
Send me a 10-second video of you biting your lip while looking straight into the camera.
Undo my belt or waistband, then stop and wait until I say please.
Text me a five-step plan for our next night in, each step wilder than the last.
Kiss me up against a wall for 30 seconds, your choice which wall.
Choose three places for me to kiss, in order, and direct me exactly.
Gently bite my lower lip, then pull back and make me come after you.
Turn off the lights and find me without saying a word. When you do, you can kiss me anywhere.
Strip to your underwear and stay that way until your next turn.
Spend two minutes exploring me with only your lips. I choose where you start.
Send me a voice note of the sound you'd make if I kissed you exactly where you want it right now.
On video, run your hand slowly from your neck to your waist while you tell me what you're thinking.
Text me a sext made only of emojis, then call me and make me translate it out loud.
Send me one rule for our next night together that I'm not allowed to break.
Send me a photo of your fridge and plan our next date-night dinner using only what's inside.
Teach me a dance move in 60 seconds. We both have to perform it before your next turn.
Text me two truths and a lie about your day. If I spot the lie, you owe me a selfie.
Pick out what I should wear tomorrow, lay it out, and explain each choice.
Send me a screenshot of the oldest photo of us on your phone, with a caption about that day.
Tuck my hair behind my ear and tell me the first thing you ever noticed about me.
Send me a voice note dedicating a song to me as if you'd called in to a late-night radio show.
Recreate the pose from our favorite photo together.
Text me a compliment you've never given me before. It has to be specific.
Rest your head on my chest for one minute, then tell me what my heartbeat sounds like.
On video, show me the spot in your home where you'd most like to kiss me, and explain why there.
Send me a photo of yourself in bed right now, under the covers, with a caption saying what's missing.
Text me exactly what you'd whisper in my ear if I were next to you right now. No softening it.
On a video call, I choose one item of clothing for you to take off, then you choose one for me.
Send me a photo showing more skin than you'd ever share anywhere else. For my eyes only.
Record a one-minute voice note describing the last time we were in bed together, and send it.
Text me the outfit, the room and the time for our next night together, and make it non-negotiable.
Send me a 30-second voice note describing my body as if you were painting it.
Take a shower with me. You do all the washing; I don't lift a finger.
Pull me onto your lap and kiss me while I keep my hands on your shoulders the whole time.
Choose one item of my clothing. I take it off, and you put it on.
Kiss your way down my stomach and stop at the waistband. No further, yet.
Lie face down and let me spell a word on your back with kisses. Guess the word.
Spend one minute kissing me only where my clothes end: neckline, sleeves and waistband.
Lie next to me, close enough to kiss, and tell me your favorite memory of us in bed. No kissing until you finish.
Do your best impression of my laugh, film it (10 seconds, tops) and send it over.
Make me a paper crown, give me an official title, and crown me.
Write a four-line poem about us and send it. Rhymes are mandatory; good rhymes are optional.
Hide somewhere in the room. If I find you within 60 seconds, I win a kiss.
Snap a photo of your hand and caption it with what you wish it were holding right now.
Sit back to back with me and describe my face from memory.
Read me the first line of a love letter to me over video, then promise to finish it by our next date.
Make me a coupon for one favor of my choice, signed and dated.
Name the outfit of mine you've liked most, and the day I wore it. You have one minute to text it.
Lace your fingers with mine and tell me three things you're looking forward to doing together.
In your sleepiest voice, record the sweetest thing you can think of and send it to me.
Kiss my forehead and hold it there for five slow breaths.
Take a photo of your neck and circle the exact spot where you want my lips first.
Top off for the rest of this video call. No putting it back on.
Out loud and on record: the steamiest message I've ever sent you. Send the recording back to me.
Three sentences, one fantasy: where we are, what you're wearing, what you do first. Text it now.
Fresh out of the shower? Prove it with a photo. The towel is optional.
Be my model for one minute on video: hold any pose I ask for, within reason.
Kiss me while you unbutton your own shirt, one button per kiss.
Lead me to the bedroom by the hand without saying a word, and close the door behind us.
Put your hands on the headboard and keep them there. For the next two minutes, I'm in charge of every touch.
Sit between my legs with your back against my chest and let my hands wander for one minute.
Be my statue for 90 seconds: freeze in any pose I put you in while I try everything to make you move.
Let me tie your hands loosely with a scarf for two minutes while I kiss you.
Lie on top of me, fully clothed, for one whole song without kissing me.
Draw the two of us as stick figures on our dream holiday and send me the masterpiece.
Rock, paper, scissors, best of five. Every round you lose, you owe me a compliment out loud.
Hunt down the most romantic song you'd never admit to liking and play it for me on a call.
Narrate this exact moment out loud, for 30 seconds, like the opening scene of our romance movie.
Guess what I'm wearing right now in five words or fewer. If you're close, I'll show you.
Slip a note into my pocket or bag with a promise you'll keep this week.
Plan our perfect lazy Sunday, hour by hour, and pitch it to me in a 30-second call.
Invent a secret handshake for the two of us and teach it to me.
Change your ringtone for me to a song that sums us up, then call me so I can hear it.
Brush your nose against mine and hold still until one of us smiles.
Choose a code word that means "I want you" and slip it into a message to me today.
Over a call, describe the first date you'd plan if we met for the first time tomorrow.
Hands behind your back for the rest of this video call: I talk, you listen, and every time they move, something comes off.
Tonight's sleepwear, or nothing at all: show me a photo before lights out.
Describe, in one recorded minute, how you'd wake me up tomorrow if you were here.
Make me a five-song playlist for our next night in, each song titled with what happens while it plays.
For the next ten minutes, you can only reply to me with "Yes", "Please" or "More". I'll make it worth it.
Rate these from 1 to 10 and send me your scores: candles, music, lingerie, the shower, the kitchen counter.
Agree on a safe word with me, then hand me control for three minutes: I decide where, how and how fast.
I give you three orders, one at a time. You may refuse exactly one.
Kiss me in slow motion: every move at half speed, for one full minute.
Find a spot in our home where we've never kissed, take me there, and fix that.
Wrap yourself around me from behind and don't let go until I say your name.
You're not allowed to make a sound for the next two minutes, no matter what I do. Break the silence and I get another two.
Dim the lights, put on our song, and make me forget what we were doing.
